d:
Azadi Records is proud to present ‘NANCHAKU'. Built upon a wonky, off-kilter production by Calm that delivers a brand new aesthetic to Indian hip-hop's sonic palette, 'Nanchaku' sees Seedhe Maut and MC Stan flex their creative juices on one of the most anticipated collaboration's to hit the Indian scene till date.
Music Credits
Written & Performed by Seedhe Maut, MC STAN
Produced by Calm (Seedhe Maut)
Mixed & Mastered by Sez On The Beat
Artwork: Anubhav Goswami
Label: Azadi Records
